facts.fact: Digital Realty's NBO2 facility in Nairobi, operated by iColo, has expanded Nairobi's data centre ecosystem and hosts an interconnection environment of cloud providers, carriers, enterprises, banks and ISPs (TechTrends Media, 2026-09-15; no opening date given, so the article date is used).

note: Nxtra Tatu City (due July 2027) and Hercules are planned, not in service; no Tier or cloud-region statement.
